name: B10-0447/2026 (ESN) – Attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on a court case in Georgia. The ruling party there, Georgian Dream, is trying to ban several opposition parties. The Parliament says banning a party should only ever be a last resort, backed by strong evidence and decided by an independent court. It urges everyone to act peacefully and not interfere in the court case. It also criticises the European Union for treating its own political parties differently from Georgia's.

- The Parliament states its view; no law changes and no action is ordered.
- It concerns Georgia's ruling party, its opposition parties and the EU institutions.
- The statement goes to EU bodies and Georgia's government and parliament.
